description: Semantic search over active Polish public tenders (przetargi) by meaning, with optional filters. Ranks by relevance (hybrid vector + keyword). Query: 1–3 keywords naming the subject of the tender, e.g. 'catering', 'wywóz odpadów', 'remont dachu' — not sentences, lists of services or a description of the company: the more words, the fewer and weaker the hits. Narrow with the filters instead (CPV codes from cpv_search, voivodeship). For the tenders that fit the user's company use list_matched_tenders — it is built from the company's matching profile (set once in the app or with set_matching_profile). Returns paginated tender cards, each with a public URL. Tenders without an AI summary yet are included: their card has has_summary=false and no teaser, get_tender returns their notice data, and a signed-in user on a trial or paid plan can order the summary in Przetargowy Janusz. `mode` is 'semantic', or 'lexical' when the embedding service is temporarily unavailable; `unapplied_filters` then lists the filters it could not apply exactly. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

buyer_types.description: Type of contracting authority — codes from list_facets buyer_types, e.g. 'gminy_miasta', 'szpitale_przychodnie'

cpv.description: Restrict to tenders whose CPV includes this code, with or without the check digit: '79952000' or '79952000-2'

cpv_codes.description: CPV codes from cpv_search, each with all its sub-codes ('79952000' also finds 79952100); a tender matches any of them

deadline_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD; submission deadline on or after that day

deadline_before.description: ISO date; only tenders with submission deadline before it

deposit.description: Whether a bid deposit (wadium) is required

notice_type.description: tenders (przetargi), market research (rozeznania rynku) or corrections (sprostowania)

published_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD; published on or after that day

published_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD; published on or before that day

query.description: Natural-language query in Polish — the tenders are in Polish, e.g. 'budowa hali sportowej z basenem'

region.description: Voivodeship (województwo): slug or name from list_facets, e.g. 'slaskie' or 'śląskie'

regions.description: Voivodeships (slug or name from list_facets); a tender matches any of them

name: search_tenders
title: Szukaj przetargów
